notes: GST is 3% on gold and silver jewellery on the total transaction value (making charges included) and 3% IGST on imports of precious metals (GST Council FAQ). Import duty rose to 15% on 13 May 2026 - 10% basic customs duty plus 5% AIDC, SWS exempt (Customs Notifications 15/2026 and 16/2026) - with 3% IGST charged on the duty-paid value on top.

sources.name: GST Council / CBEC - Sectoral FAQ: Gems & Jewellery
sources.what: Q7: GST is payable at 3% of the total transaction value of gold, diamond or silver jewellery, whether the making charge is shown separately or not. Q2 and Q4: 3% IGST is payable on all imports of precious metals and GST is payable at 3% - so gold and silver, bullion and jewellery, all take 3%.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance, Notification No. 15/2026-Customs, G.S.R. 358(E), 12 May 2026 (notification text as published)
sources.what: Amends Notification No. 45/2025-Customs Table I, substituting 10% for 5% against S. Nos. 192-197, 202 and 203 (gold dore, silver dore, gold and silver bars, coins and ornaments), in force 13 May 2026 - basic customs duty on gold and silver is 10%. With the 5% AIDC set by Notification No. 16/2026-Customs (amending Notification No. 11/2021-Customs; SWS exempt), the total import duty coded is 15% (10% BCD + 5% AIDC).
